product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Pinzon Cotton Flannel Bed Sheet Set - King, Sage
features: Made in Portugal; King set includes flat sheet, fitted sheet, and 2 king-size pillowcases
Velvet flannel provides luxurious softness in a breathable weave

Designed with a 4-inch hem on flat sheet and pillowcases
Machine washable and dryable; made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards.
